summary: Upgrades django-lux to 1.8.4, moves product/service/listing images into the dlux asset library, puts the reports and builders on the Ribbon, and rebuilds stock balances after a data reset.
highlights: Images are ManagedAssetFields namespaced per model, with instant upload and camera capture; adopt_image_assets backfills the old files.
Inventory Valuation, Sales Overview, Sales Report, Financial Report and both public-site builders now carry the dlux Ribbon.
Six more list pages gained descriptions, and the ribbon's layout switch renders as one segmented control.
Stock balances rebuild from the live ledger after a data reset, fixing products that kept stock once their movements were cleared.
